title: Tanvir Hasan Khan v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shashi Kant Gupta, J. and Shamim Ahmed, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; objections before EE; stay; s.127 liberty.
headnote: A writ challenging electricity recovery notices and a citation is disposed of without examining the alleged breach of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The consumer must appear before the Executive Engineer with objections and evidence; a speaking and reasoned final order is to follow; coercive action is stayed for a limited period; any remaining grievance lies in an appeal under Section 127 of the Electricity Act, 2003; and non-appearance automatically revives the citation.
facts: Tanvir Hasan Khan filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court seeking to quash recovery determination notices dated 18 July 2019 and 16 August 2019 and a recovery citation dated 18 November 2019 issued by officers of Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited at Badaun. He contended that the electricity department was taking coercive recovery action without affording a hearing and without following the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel for the petitioner and for the electricity department were heard.

holding_units.topic: recovery citation — speaking final order and section 127 appeal
holding_units.holding: A writ challenging electricity recovery notices and a citation is disposed of, without a merits decision, by directing the consumer to appear before the Executive Engineer with objections and evidence; requiring a speaking and reasoned final order within four weeks; staying coercive action for six weeks or until the objection is decided, whichever is earlier; and leaving the consumer, if still aggrieved by that final order, to appeal under Section 127 of the Electricity Act, 2003. Non-appearance on the date fixed automatically revives the recovery citation.

principle_tags.application: After directing a speaking final order on the consumer's objections to recovery notices and a citation, the Court left any remaining grievance to an appeal under Section 127 of the Electricity Act, 2003, without examining the alleged Supply Code breach on merits.

The Court treated the impugned recovery notices and citation as not themselves the appealable final order, directing the Executive Engineer to pass a speaking final order before Section 127 would be available.

not_decided.point: Whether the recovery notices and citation violated the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 or were issued without opportunity of hearing
not_decided.note: The petitioner's principal contention was not examined; the Court took a lenient view and directed a speaking final order on objections.
